page_title: PAL 0-2 BIL | Las Palmas v Athletic Bilbao 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Pejino (Las Palmas) swings in a cross from the corner, but Unai Simon reads it well and gathers the ball.

90+4' The ball is cleared after Marvin (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+3' Pejino (Las Palmas) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+2' The resulting corner, taken by Pejino (Las Palmas), comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' What was Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

90+1' Nice individual effort by Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Pejino (Las Palmas) is replacing Sandro Ramirez.
85' The foul by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) was seen by Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
84' The resulting corner from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is cleared.
81' The main referee, Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas) is given a yellow card for dissent.

78' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Marvin.
74' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
74' Yuri Berchiche is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao).

70' Here is a change. Nico Williams is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
70' Oscar de Marcos will be replaced by Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).
70' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

69' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

38' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
36' The referee blows his whistle, Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) makes the score 0:1 after burying a close-range header in the bottom left corner after a good run and cross by Nico Williams.

26' 1:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

20' Neat passing move from Las Palmas in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.

15' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) finds himself some space and fires in a superb first-time shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. Alvaro Valles is alert and makes a good save to deny him.

9' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Yuri Berchiche, but his close-range header slips just over the bar.
8' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
8' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
6' Las Palmas enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
5' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
